purpose: Phase-7C immune prediction records. Prediction is enabled ONLY as an evidence-aware mechanistic fallback (relative immune posture + direction), NEVER as clinical immunotherapy prediction. Each record documents the assumptions required to run the Phase-7C runtime - it never fabricates immune-cell counts, checkpoint expression, cytotoxicity, or cytokine levels. Allowed labels are enumerated in prediction_labels.

pred_im_b16bl6.mechanistic_basis: B16BL6 melanoma is generally poorly immunogenic with an immunosuppressive microenvironment; applied predictively to establish a baseline immune posture. No direct immune dataset.
assumptions: component biology populated in later sections
pred_im_b16bl6.expected_direction: moderate immunosuppression + limited immune-mediated tumour loss; endogenous checkpoint pressure present
pred_im_b16bl6.uncertainty: Relative posture + direction only; all quantities NOT_REPORTED.
pred_im_b16bl6.falsifiability_statement: A B16BL6 tripterine-NLC immune-profiling study showing strong endogenous anti-tumour immunity would contradict this prediction.
pred_im_b16bl6.limitations: Not a measured immune profile; schematic; Section 1 exposes components as UNAVAILABLE.

pred_im_human.source_context: general tumour-immunology biology (human skin melanoma, exploratory)
pred_im_human.species_transfer: none (human context defined with own distinct values, not transferred from mouse)
pred_im_human.mechanistic_basis: Human skin melanoma is predicted to show a heterogeneous immune posture; exploratory only.
assumptions: own distinct values (not copied from mouse)
not validated for human clinical immune response
pred_im_human.expected_direction: heterogeneous immune posture with higher uncertainty
pred_im_human.uncertainty: Entirely predictive; all quantities NOT_REPORTED; not shown by default.
pred_im_human.falsifiability_statement: Any validated human dataset contradicting a heterogeneous immune posture for this context would falsify this exploratory prediction.
pred_im_human.limitations: Exploratory; mandated non-clinical warning; not shown by default.

policy.no_clinical_prediction: These records describe assumptions required to run Phase 7C; they are NOT clinical immunotherapy / checkpoint-blockade / survival predictions.
policy.never_fabricate: No immune-cell count, checkpoint expression, cytotoxicity, cytokine level, or HLA type is produced.
policy.prediction_distinguishable: Every predicted immune relationship is programmatically distinguishable from an evidence-supported one (there are none here) via its prediction label.
